Feta Phyllo Bites! Another awesome #appetizer for Memorial Day! Comment "recipe" and I'll send it your way! 

#reels #appetizers #recipes #feta
author: Food My Muse
transcript: If you're into easy, but impressive appetizers, look no further. These are perfection. They are buttery, crispy, cheesy, a little bit sweet. Like I said, they're very easy to make. All you need is some phyllo, some butter to add in between the sheets, some feta, fake preserves, chives, spices, and pistachio. Gonna wrap them really, really tightly, cut with a very sharp knife, bake with some butter until nice and golden. Drizzle with honey and that is it.
title: Crispy Feta Phyllo Bites with Honey
one_liner: Easy buttery phyllo appetizers filled with feta, fig preserves, and pistachios, drizzled with honey.
key_points: Layer phyllo sheets with butter between each sheet
Fill with feta, fig preserves, chives, spices, and pistachios
Roll tightly, slice with a sharp knife, and bake until golden
Finish with a honey drizzle before serving

instructions: 1. Layer phyllo sheets with melted butter between each layer.
2. Add feta, fig preserves, chives, spices, and pistachios as filling.
3. Roll the phyllo tightly around the filling.
4. Cut into pieces with a sharp knife.
5. Brush with butter and bake until nice and golden.
